# Oh My Cassette

> Oh My Cassette is an open-source MCP server (PyPI: `oh-my-cassette`) that lets Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes drive the Cassette video editor: import local media, send the user's editing requests to the Cassette agent one turn at a time, read the versioned timeline back, undo/redo, and export.

Hosts start it with `uvx oh-my-cassette==0.5.0`. It talks to a Cassette-Editor backend (`/api/agent/*` runtime) over HTTP and SSE; nothing renders during an edit. Each turn returns a typed `status`, the agent's answer, `version_from→version_to`, a bounded timeline digest and an `editor_url` the user can open to watch live. MIT licensed.
